remarks: Welcome to this bright and spacious 1-bedroom corner unit, ideally located in a quiet, well-maintained building with convenient elevator access. Nestled right on the Darien border, you're just minutes from shopping, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Metro-North-making commuting and daily errands effortless. Step inside to discover an airy, open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the kitchen, living, and dining areas. High ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light create a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. This rare opportunity offers a peaceful retreat with unbeatable accessibility-ideal for anyone seeking a stylish and convenient lifestyle in one perfect package. Very good credit a must (700+), NO evictions/good references from previous landlords. 1 pet welcome (cat/dog 15lb or less).
